verified: Classic grid (EON Steel Black product photo, test_data/dive_computers/suunto): depth | dive time, the stop / ceiling depth | no deco or asc. time, the gas or CC | tank or setpoint, the grey dividers, grey lowercase labels with units, minutes with a prime
Colours sampled from the photos: dive time and no deco green, asc. time orange, gas / tank / CC / setpoint cyan, the clock yellow-green
Ascent bar on the left, one segment per 2 m/min, green / yellow / red (EON Core manual p.15)
Safety stop counted between 2.4 and 6 m on dives over 10 m, the counter in m'ss, yellow (p.25, p.40)
Deco: ceiling, m and asc. time in orange (p.25-27); CC, SP and pO2 after a bailout, OC (p.39-40)
Pop-ups: a dark box with a coloured border (p.13-14)
assumed: Positions: measured on the Steel Black photo (the same firmware look) and mapped onto the EON Core photo's display area; the Core skin is a 447 px product photo, soft when enlarged
Font: Roboto Condensed for the device's condensed face (narrower on the device)
Row 2 left in normal diving: max, m (the manual shows max / avg in the switch window, p.31)
Right-edge scale: the no-deco time over 0-100 min, orange time to surface in deco (the manual does not describe it)
not_shown: Battery icon and remaining dive hours (no log holds them)
Deepstops, the red mandatory safety stop, Locked / Ceiling broken after 3 minutes above the ceiling
Prominent and Graphical styles, the compass, timer and tank views (to come)
notes._about: What this template reproduces of the real screen and what it does not; manual pages in hud_rules_sources.md
